assertions: An invited verified identity accepts a one-time invitation.
The invited identity resolves the same organization context through session bootstrap.
The invited identity can read the organization site and machine surface.
The invited identity can update machine metadata.
The invited identity can list members and toggle another membership active/inactive.
No doctor/engineer action role or approval branch is used in the test.
limitations: This is a local synthetic identity test, not a Supabase two-account browser test.
It does not verify Railway PostgreSQL rows, invitation token hash, audit persistence, concurrency, or staging delivery.
